title: Kazim Tere Laashe Pa Nazar Ati Hai Zehra
body:
Kaazim (asws) Tere Laashe Pa Nazar Aati Hai Zahra (asws)
Zanjeer ko zakhmoÃ± se juda karti hai Zahra (asws)
1 - HAYE KARRIYON SEY LASHEY KO tere jakda hai aise
Ho teer ya talwar koi jism me jaise
Ye dekh ke aankhon se lahu roti hai Zahra (asws)
2 - maathey pa terey maekh jo zaalim ne hai maari
Maula (asws) terey maathey pa laga zakhm hai kaari
Is manzar e pur dard pa ghash khati hai Zahra (s.a)
3 - Tanha teri maiyat ko jo rakkha gaya pul per
Rakkha nahi balkey tujhey phenka Gaya pul per
Ghurbat ko teri dekh tadap jati hai Zahra (s.a)
4 - khooÃ± mein bhare shanoÃ± ko jo Kaazim (asws) terey dekha
Abbas (asws) kay shanoÃ± ne bhi tujh par kiya giriya
Daman mein terey baazu chhupa leti hai Zahra (s.a)
5 - Karta raha tableegh e Aliyun Waliyullah
Is waastey kaazim ko bhi mara gaya Wallah
Nauha teri maiyat pa yehi padhti hai zehra (s.a)
6 - Jab Shimr e sitamgar (al) key tamachoÃ± ko kiya yaad
Roya wo Sakina (s.a) ko bahot ki badi faryaad
Aanchal sey tabhi us ko hawa deti hai Zahra (s.a)
7 - Sajjad (as) ko zindaÃ± mein bohat roya hai Kazim a.s
Sar os ka patakna raha har raat ko lazim
Haider ko bohat rokay ye batlaati hai Zahra (as)

KyuÃ± sun ke na har Matmi khooÃ± apna bahaye
